text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mauritius business want to take over Mozambique's biggest sugar company, Sena Sugar Estates, on the Zambezi River, but only when the railway line from the mills to the port of Beira is rehabilitated.

- Mozambique President Joaquim Chissano is to visit the United States from April 19 to 22 to take part in a meeting aimed at attracting capital to Africa. The presidents of Uganda, the Ivory Coast and Ethiopia will also attend the meeting organised by the U.S Corporate Council on Africa.
